# Roleplay Rule 4 - You Control the Character
"It's what my character would do!" is not a valid excuse for bad behavior: you control the character, and you decide how your character would act and behave.
[textlink="Roleplay may be king" link="RuleRoleplayAboveAll"], but if your character would constantly be doing something that would break the server rules, then you shouldn't be playing that character.
A critical part of playing a character who is employed on station is that your character is a [textlink="MODERATELY FUNCTIONAL ADULT" link="RuleEffort"] and would not act like a child, a mental patient, or an animal/pet. Failure to act like an employable adult will be punished heavily. This is doubly true for [color=#1b67a5][bold]Command[/bold][/color]: If you cannot take your job seriously, you will be banned from playing [color=#1b67a5][bold]Command[/bold][/color] roles.
## Precedents
- "My character has anger issues" is not a valid reason to [textlink="over-escalate" link="RuleEscalate"] and/or kill somebody. - "But my character WOULD fall to nepotism!" is not a good enough reason for you to start [textlink="metafriending" link="RuleMetagameMetafriend"] and giving your friends all-access as the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Captain[/bold][/color]. - "But my character is paranoid!" is not a good enough reason to start [textlink="powergaming" link="RuleMetagamePowergaming"]. - "But my character hates Nanotrasen!" is not a good enough reason to start [textlink="self-antagging" link="RuleSelfantag"] or being an excessive nuisance.
